entities.name: Query proteasome beta
observations: 302 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 32.78 kDa and theoretical pI 5.74.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt C7R403, annotated as proteasome subunit beta from Jonesia denitrificans.
Pfam Proteasome domain PF00227 detected at residues 49–227.

Proteasome beta subunits undergo N-terminal propeptide removal by autocatalysis; the mature-chain nucleophile is the newly exposed N-terminal threonine, corresponding to position 51 in the exact reference.
Expected to be a catalytic component of the bacterial 20S proteasome core.

entities.name: Proteasomal protein degradation
observations: The bacterial proteasome core mediates modification-dependent and proteasomal protein catabolism; the associated pathway is the proteasomal Pup-dependent degradation system.
The 20S core is typically capped or regulated by a proteasome-associated ATPase such as ARC in the referenced organisms.

entities.name: Bacterial 20S proteasome core
observations: The complex is a barrel-shaped 20S core comprising four stacked heptameric rings: two alpha rings and two beta rings.
Beta subunits form the two inner catalytic rings, with active sites facing the internal proteolytic chamber.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic; the sequence lacks features suggesting secretion or membrane insertion.
